name: Asparagus

schedule.notes: Plant 1-year-old crowns 6 in deep in a permanent bed — they'll produce for 15 to 20 years.
NO harvest year 1 or 2. Light harvest year 3 (2 weeks). Full harvest year 4+ (6 to 8 weeks).

harvest.cues: Spears 6 to 8 in tall, pencil-thick, before tips loosen. Snap or cut at the soil line.
harvest.storageNotes: Stems in a jar of water in the fridge 1 week. Best fresh — sugar converts to starch within hours.

varieties.name: Jersey Knight
varieties.notes: All-male = no seedy volunteers. Vigorous, rust-resistant. Heavy yields.

varieties.name: Purple Passion
varieties.notes: Purple spears, sweeter and less fibrous. Color fades when cooked.

notes: Commit to a permanent spot — beds last 15 to 20+ years. Cut down dead fronds AFTER they brown in fall to let energy return to crowns. Mulch heavily annually.
